title: Immunity and inflammation in classic Hodgkin lymphoma: Bridging diagnosis, prognosis and precision medicine.
snippet: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma (cHL) is a unique B-cell malignancy characterized by a small number of malignant Hodgkin and Reed-Sternberg (HRS) cells embedded within an extensive and highly organized inflammatory microenvironment.
